usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the available sub-resources under the /config/access namespace in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. It functions as a directory index and requires no elevated privileges — any authenticated user or API token may call it. The response structure is null-typed in the spec, meaning the API returns a list of child endpoints rather than a domain object.
tips: No query parameters are accepted; passing any will be silently ignored or rejected.
Because permissions are 'user: all', this is safe to call with any valid API token for capability discovery.
Use the returned directory entries to determine which /config/access/* endpoints exist before drilling into a specific sub-resource.
